name: Proving Grounds - contact detonation (the baneling rule shape)
notes: Mario's second requested design: a ground unit that explodes for radius damage on contact, not on death. Spitters carry no attack at all - detonation.triggerRange is the whole mechanic - so a squad of them closing on a formation should visibly pop as they arrive rather than fight normally first. Distinct from the existing Ravel detonation (unit.ravel.runner etc.), which only ever fires once something else kills the carrier.
